method: Forced-GC V8 heap snapshots over CDP (HeapProfiler.takeHeapSnapshot) from l27-packaged.cjs --heap-at; analysed with scripts/launch/l27-heap-analyze.cjs (dominator tree + shortest retaining path) and a BFS-ancestor grouping.
build: Packaged QA copy tmp/l27qa/app (LOCAL-QA-ONLY, Steam disabled), built from f9358233; fresh week-1 career seeded by l27-seed-profile.ts --fresh

baselineWeek52.stateCopies: 1 live players array; no stale store states held by subscribers, selectors or memo caches

rootCause1.what: Harness artefact: Playwright page.waitForSelector() returns an ElementHandle that the CDP remote-object table keeps until disposed. One per own match (the tactics page "Simulate Result Instantly" button), each pinning the unmounted tactics page: fiber -> props/closures -> a whole old game state.
rootCause1.evidence: ~30 GC roots labelled "N / DevTools console" -> <button data-slot=button data-variant=outline> -> fiber tree, 5-12 MB each; reachable heap 209 MB (handles leaked) vs 80 MB (same build, no leaked handles) at week 52

rootCause2.what: App: SaveManager.lastVerifiedPrimary kept the full serialized save text between saves

evidence.path: context→system / Context / scope @183395 . v→k . lastVerifiedPrimary→Object . value→string

rootCause2.fix: store a fingerprint (length + full head/tail 64 KiB + every 31st char) instead of the text
